text: Run a Kimi K3 one-idea loop compatibility experiment
description: Configure a duplicated loop with provider OpenRouter, base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, model moonshotai/kimi-k3, a clean worktree, and one atomic coding idea. Compare tool-call success, cycles, verification quality, diff quality, latency, and actual cost against the current provider. Do not start until an OpenRouter key and spending authorization are available.

status.comment: Still needs an OpenRouter key and spending authorization for Kimi K3. Note 2026-11-08: Kimi K2.6 (moonshotai/kimi-k2.6) is served on the existing NVIDIA key at no extra cost, and the harness now has per-role models (loops.json roles) and per-cycle traces for exactly this comparison. Question for Felix: is K2.6 on NVIDIA a good enough proxy to run the comparison now, or is K3 specifically the point?
